mechanical-v1 is a permanent INFRA_FAIL: the lean cloud launcher omitted third_party/diffusers_h3/src and exited at the first online-H3 layout import with ModuleNotFoundError before producing a report or model verdict.

mechanical-v2 repeated the old d2 snapshot missing-diffusers failure; mechanical-v3 reached the first H3 linear under h3-int8-native but lacked the cloud NVIDIA library path and exited with CUBLAS_STATUS_NOT_INITIALIZED. Neither produced a report or verdict.

mechanical-v4 passed the infrastructure preflight and is a permanent MECHANICAL_FAIL: real clean-action feedback at FP32 timestep zero reached a BF16 ActionDiT Linear without autocast and failed mat1 Float versus mat2 BF16 before report generation.

The minimal model fix preserves the FP32 continuous timestep and establishes the same BF16/FP16 autocast boundary used by C58 training inside the public feedback API; a CPU BF16 full feedback-commit regression test covers the repaired path.

mechanical-v5 and mechanical-v6 are permanent INFRA_PREFLIGHT_FAIL runs: the 64x64 BF16/FP16 GEMM probe intermittently returned CUBLAS_STATUS_INVALID_VALUE under nohup, while the same environment sometimes passed interactively, stable 256x256 probes passed in both dtypes, and v4 had already entered real H3 forward. Neither run produced a report, optimizer step, or model verdict.

The launcher now pins the H3 diffusers before_denoise.py SHA256 530b007c, defaults to h3-int8-native, exports /usr/local/nvidia/lib and lib64, and uses a stable 256x256 CUDA BF16/FP16 tensor-core matmul preflight. A clean new directory must rerun every gate; v1 through v6 cannot be reused.
No optimizer step or C66 training checkpoint is authorized before the real checkpoint/data gate passes.
No episode-disjoint clean-vs-history-shuffle C66 result exists.
No C66 rollout is allowed before mechanical and bounded effect gates.

decision.rationale: C66 is not a post-hoc adapter: the committed prefix is read inside all thirty existing C58 attention blocks and clean executed-action K/V is generated by those same blocks. Source and unit gates pass. Runs v1-v3 and v5-v6 were infrastructure-only failures; v4 exposed and motivated a repaired BF16 feedback dtype contract. A clean mechanical retry is required and training remains forbidden.
